source.title: Home Networking: 100TB 10Gbit Server - Installing Proxmox and basic ZFS tutorial
source.description: Now that the server is starting, let's install Proxmox, do some basic Proxmox setup stuff and create a ZFS pool and do an install of a Linux VM! Jump links: 0:00 Introduction to this video 01:35 Downloading Proxmox and writing to USB stick 02:20 BIOS settings 04:00 Proxmox installer & setting up ZFS Mirror bootdrives 06:45 Opening the Proxmox webinterface and enabling updates 09:00 Configure simple RAIDz1 pool from 5 disks 12:00 Adding ZFS pool as Proxmox storage 12:25 Create ZFS dataset and ISO location 13:20 Uploading ISO file and setting up a VM 15:00 Future videos about the server If you'd like to discuss more in depth, join our discord server: https://discordapp.com/invite/abk5kuD ░▒▓[Associated blog post]▓▒░ The blog/article index for this server can be found here: https://blog.quindorian.org/2019/08/building-a-100tb-10gbit-home-server.html/ Text parts for this video: https://blog.quindorian.org/2019/08/how-to-install-proxmox-and-setup-a-zfs-pool.html/ Video about the server chassis: https://youtu.be/swWgav-p2Nw Video about preparing to build in the chassis: https://youtu.be/fU4sEzTqAwk Video about the hardware used for this server build: https://youtu.be/O2QV0ZTFaxk Video about installing Proxmox and setting up ZFS: https://youtu.be/ZL2JUL9oeDg ░▒▓[Shopping links]▓▒░ Most links will ask if you are looking on Amazon or Aliexpress. I prefer Aliexpress myself. These are affiliate links and help me out greatly! Sadly the Inter-Tech 4U 4420 is currently only available on A…
